notes.title: 1.26 path extension
notes.notes:
The new 1.26 version contains the prototype of the jukebox, more songs will be added soon!
Also:
 - Level 14-20 improved/revamped (watch the twitchs -> user juaxix )
 - Use keys: 
    + J or Select GamePad button : show jukebox
    + K or L1 GamePad button: prev song
    + L or R1 GamePad button: next song
 - More improvements in steering behaviours and overall AI

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Thanks to the users comments, here it is, some changes!:
+ New HUD element : a new cam in a window will appear to see what dangers are trying to eat the animals.
+ New animations and sounds
+ Improvement in the herding: the herding is more natural and easy now, it feels so good!
+ Now the version of the game will be displayed in the main menu
+ Bug fixes: controls, animals displacements, weird bugs.
+ Use the mouse wheel or gamepad triggers (L2,R2) to zoom the camera in and out
